headline: Oil heads for its third straight weekly decline due to Middle East export flows
summary: Oil prices fell on Friday and were on course for a weekly decline, their third in a row. Strong exports from the Middle East weighed on prices.
why: Brent crude is the global benchmark for oil, and Middle East exporters supply a large share of world crude. Oil prices feed into inflation, transport costs and energy company earnings.
why_moved: Strong crude exports from the Middle East are weighing on prices, which are heading for a third consecutive weekly fall.
original_headline: Petróleo se dirige a su tercera caída semanal al hilo por los flujos de exportación de Oriente Medio
